input.description:
A cozy living room with a light beige carpet covering the floor. In the center of the room is a fireplace with a black marble surround and a white mantel. Inside the fireplace, there are decorative logs. To the left of the fireplace, there is a small wooden chair with a green stuffed animal sitting on it. Next to the chair is an exercise bike. On the right side of the fireplace, there is a red toy truck placed on the floor. 

A large flat-screen TV is positioned on a black glass TV stand in the corner of the room. The stand has several shelves with electronic devices and other items. In the foreground, part of a dark-colored sofa is visible with a fluffy light-colored blanket draped over the armrest. 

On the left side of the image, there is a wooden coffee table with several colorful stuffed animals and decorative items on the lower shelf. The room is well-lit, with natural light coming in from an unseen source, casting soft shadows on the carpet.
